question.english: What is IEPF?
question.hinglish: IEPF kya hai?
question.hindi: IEPF क्या है?

answer.english: The Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) is a fund set up by the Indian government to protect the interests of investors and promote investor awareness. It is primarily funded by unclaimed dividends, shares, and other amounts that have remained unclaimed by investors for a period of seven years.
answer.hinglish: Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Bharat sarkar dwara niveshakon ke hiton ki suraksha aur unki jagrukta badhane ke liye banaya gaya ek fund hai. Isme mainly woh dividend, shares aur paise hote hain jo 7 saal tak claim na hone ke baad yahan transfer ho jaate hain.
answer.hindi: Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) भारत सरकार द्वारा निवेशकों के हितों की रक्षा और जागरूकता बढ़ाने के लिए स्थापित एक निधि है। इसमें मुख्य रूप से वे लाभांश, शेयर और अन्य राशियाँ शामिल होती हैं जो सात वर्षों तक दावा न किए जाने के कारण संचित हो जाती हैं।

question.english: Why companies should transfer the shares to IEPF?
question.hinglish: Companies ko shares IEPF mein kyun transfer karne chahiye?
question.hindi: कंपनियों को शेयर IEPF में क्यों ट्रांसफर करने चाहिए?

answer.english: Companies are legally obligated under Section 124 of the Companies Act, 2013 to transfer shares to the IEPF if they remain unclaimed for seven years. This ensures better governance and protects investor interests by preventing companies from misusing unclaimed assets.
answer.hinglish: Companies Companies Act, 2013 ke Section 124 ke under legally bound hoti hain ki agar kisi share pe 7 saal tak koi claim nahi aaya ho to use IEPF mein transfer kar diya jaye. Isse governance strong hoti hai aur investors ka interest safe rehta hai.
answer.hindi: कंपनियाँ कंपनियों अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 124 के अंतर्गत कानूनी रूप से बाध्य होती हैं कि यदि शेयरों पर सात वर्षों तक कोई दावा नहीं किया गया हो तो उन्हें IEPF में ट्रांसफर किया जाए। इससे बेहतर गवर्नेंस सुनिश्चित होती है और निवेशकों के हित सुरक्षित रहते हैं।

question.english: Who is handling IEPF authority?
question.hinglish: IEPF authority ka operation kaun karta hai?
question.hindi: IEPF प्राधिकरण का संचालन कौन करता है?

answer.english: The IEPF authority is managed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India.
answer.hinglish: IEPF authority ka operation Bharat sarkar ke Ministry of Corporate Affairs ke under hota hai.
answer.hindi: IEPF प्राधिकरण का संचालन भारत सरकार के कॉर्पोरेट कार्य मंत्रालय (Ministry of Corporate Affairs) द्वारा किया जाता है।

question.english: Are IEPF shares available with the company?
question.hinglish: Kya IEPF shares company ke paas hote hain?
question.hindi: क्या IEPF शेयर कंपनी के पास होते हैं?

answer.english: No, once shares are transferred to IEPF, they are no longer held by the company. They are under the custody of the IEPF authority.
answer.hinglish: Nahi, ek baar shares IEPF mein transfer ho jaayein to wo company ke paas nahi rehte, balki IEPF authority ke custody mein chale jaate hain.
answer.hindi: नहीं, एक बार जब शेयर IEPF को ट्रांसफर हो जाते हैं तो वे कंपनी के पास नहीं रहते, बल्कि IEPF प्राधिकरण की कस्टडी में चले जाते हैं।

question.english: When are shares transferred to the IEPF account?
question.hinglish: Shares kab IEPF account mein transfer hote hain?
question.hindi: शेयर कब IEPF खाते में ट्रांसफर होते हैं?

answer.english: Shares are transferred to the IEPF account after seven years of remaining unclaimed. This period starts from the date the dividend was declared or the shares were due for transfer.
answer.hinglish: Jab kisi dividend ya share pe 7 saal tak koi claim nahi aata, tab woh IEPF account mein transfer ho jaata hai. Yeh period us din se count hota hai jab dividend declare hua ya share transfer hone layak bana tha.
answer.hindi: जब किसी लाभांश या शेयर पर सात वर्षों तक कोई दावा नहीं किया गया हो, तब वे IEPF खाते में ट्रांसफर कर दिए जाते हैं। यह अवधि उस तिथि से शुरू होती है जब लाभांश घोषित किया गया था या शेयर ट्रांसफर के योग्य हुए थे।

question.english: What is the time period to claim shares in case shares are transferred to IEPF?
question.hinglish: Agar shares IEPF mein transfer ho jaayein to claim karne ki time limit kya hai?
question.hindi: यदि शेयर IEPF में ट्रांसफर हो जाएं तो उन्हें क्लेम करने की समयसीमा क्या है?

answer.english: An investor can claim their shares from the IEPF anytime after they have been transferred. There is no specific time limit as such.
answer.hinglish: Investor kabhi bhi IEPF se apne shares claim kar sakta hai. Iske liye koi fixed time limit nahi hai.
answer.hindi: निवेशक IEPF से अपने शेयर कभी भी क्लेम कर सकते हैं, इसकी कोई निर्धारित समयसीमा नहीं है।

question.english: What are Unclaimed Shares?
question.hinglish: Unclaimed Shares kya hote hain?
question.hindi: Unclaimed Shares क्या होते हैं?

answer.english: Unclaimed shares are shares that have not been claimed by the shareholders. This can happen due to a number of reasons, including death, change of address, or loss of share certificates
answer.hinglish: Unclaimed shares woh hote hain jinpe shareholder ne claim nahi kiya hota — ye death, address change ya share certificate kho jaane ki wajah se ho sakta hai.
answer.hindi: Unclaimed Shares वे शेयर होते हैं जिन पर शेयरधारक द्वारा दावा नहीं किया गया हो। ऐसा मृत्यु, पता बदलने या शेयर सर्टिफिकेट खो जाने के कारण हो सकता है।

question.english: What is Unclaimed Dividend?
question.hinglish: Unclaimed Dividend kya hota hai?
question.hindi: Unclaimed Dividend क्या होता है?

answer.english: An unclaimed dividend is a dividend that a company has declared but a shareholder has not collected within the specified time.
answer.hinglish: Unclaimed dividend woh hota hai jo company ne declare kiya ho lekin shareholder ne usse receive nahi kiya ho specified time ke andar.
answer.hindi: Unclaimed Dividend वह लाभांश होता है जिसे कंपनी ने घोषित किया हो लेकिन शेयरधारक ने निर्दिष्ट समय के भीतर प्राप्त नहीं किया हो।

question.english: What are Physical Shares?
question.hinglish: Physical Shares kya hote hain?
question.hindi: Physical Shares क्या होते हैं?

answer.english: Physical shares are share certificates issued in paper form as evidence of ownership. These are different from dematerialized shares which are held electronically.
answer.hinglish: Physical shares paper certificate ke form mein diye jaate hain. Ye demat shares se alag hote hain jo electronic form mein hote hain.
answer.hindi: Physical Shares वे शेयर होते हैं जो कागज के प्रमाणपत्र के रूप में जारी किए जाते हैं। ये डिमैट शेयरों से अलग होते हैं जो इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखे जाते हैं।

question.english: When are shares transferred to the Suspense Account?
question.hinglish: Shares Suspense Account mein kab transfer hote hain?
question.hindi: शेयर Suspense Account में कब ट्रांसफर होते हैं?

answer.english: Shares are transferred to a Suspense Account when dividends remain unclaimed or unpaid for seven consecutive years or more. This is done in accordance with the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Rules.
answer.hinglish: Agar 7 saal ya usse zyada time tak dividend claim nahi kiya gaya ho to shares Suspense Account mein transfer ho jaate hain, as per IEPF rules.
answer.hindi: यदि लगातार सात वर्षों या उससे अधिक समय तक लाभांश का दावा नहीं किया गया हो, तो शेयर Suspense Account में ट्रांसफर कर दिए जाते हैं। यह प्रक्रिया IEPF नियमों के अनुसार होती है।

question.english: What is the Face Value of Shares?
question.hinglish: Share ki Face Value kya hoti hai?
question.hindi: शेयर की Face Value क्या होती है?

answer.english: The face value of a share is the original price of a share when it's first issued by a company. It's also known as the nominal or par value.
answer.hinglish: Face Value woh moolya hota hai jis par share ko company ne first time issue kiya tha. Isse nominal value bhi kaha jaata hai.
answer.hindi: Face Value वह मूल मूल्य होता है जिस पर शेयर को कंपनी द्वारा पहली बार जारी किया गया होता है। इसे नाममात्र मूल्य या पार मूल्य भी कहा जाता है।

question.english: Is the Number of Shares Increased if the company has Split its Face Value?
question.hinglish: Agar company ne Face Value split kiya ho to kya share quantity badhti hai?
question.hindi: यदि कंपनी ने Face Value को Split किया हो तो क्या शेयरों की संख्या बढ़ जाती है?

answer.english: Yes, when a company splits its face value (e.g., a share with a face value of Rs. 10 is split into 2 shares of Rs. 5 each), the number of shares increases proportionally, but the total value remains the same.
answer.hinglish: Haan, agar ₹10 ka share ₹5 mein split hota hai to share ki quantity double ho jaati hai. Value wahi rehti hai.
answer.hindi: हाँ, जब कंपनी Face Value को Split करती है (जैसे ₹10 का शेयर दो ₹5 के शेयरों में), तो शेयरों की संख्या अनुपातिक रूप से बढ़ जाती है लेकिन कुल मूल्य वही रहता है।

question.english: Is the Number of Shares Increased if the company has declared a Bonus Issue?
question.hinglish: Agar company ne Bonus Issue declare kiya ho to kya shares badhte hain?
question.hindi: यदि कंपनी ने Bonus Issue घोषित की हो तो क्या शेयरों की संख्या बढ़ती है?

answer.english: Yes, in a bonus issue, the company allots additional shares to existing shareholders for free, based on their existing holdings. This increases the number of shares held by each shareholder.
answer.hinglish: Haan, Bonus Issue mein company free shares deti hai existing shareholders ko. Isse unke paas shares zyada ho jaate hain.
answer.hindi: हाँ, Bonus Issue में कंपनी मौजूदा शेयरधारकों को उनके होल्डिंग के आधार पर अतिरिक्त शेयर मुफ्त में देती है। इससे हर शेयरधारक के पास शेयरों की संख्या बढ़ जाती है।

question.english: Can we directly file an IEPF Form for Claiming Shares?
question.hinglish: Kya hum direct IEPF form bhar ke share claim kar sakte hain?
question.hindi: क्या हम सीधे IEPF फॉर्म भरकर शेयर क्लेम कर सकते हैं?

answer.english: Yes, you can directly file an IEPF Form (IEPF-5) for claiming your shares or dividend from the IEPF website.
answer.hinglish: Haan, aap IEPF-5 form online bhar ke IEPF website se apne shares ya dividend ka claim kar sakte hain.
answer.hindi: हाँ, आप सीधे IEPF-5 फॉर्म भरकर IEPF वेबसाइट के माध्यम से अपने शेयर या लाभांश का दावा कर सकते हैं।

question.english: What to do with the shares of your Father/Grandfather?
question.hinglish: Apne father/dada ke shares ke liye kya karna chahiye?
question.hindi: अपने पिता/दादा के शेयरों के लिए क्या करना चाहिए?

answer.english: If the shares are still in physical form and not claimed for a long time, you need to first get them transmitted in your name through a legal process (like a will or succession certificate). After that, you can claim them from the company or IEPF, as applicable.
answer.hinglish: Agar shares physical form mein hain to pehle legal process (like will ya succession certificate) se unhe apne naam transfer karwana padega. Fir claim kiya ja sakta hai.
answer.hindi: यदि शेयर अभी भी फिजिकल फॉर्म में हैं और लंबे समय से क्लेम नहीं किए गए हैं, तो आपको पहले कानूनी प्रक्रिया (जैसे वसीयत या उत्तराधिकार प्रमाणपत्र) के माध्यम से उन्हें अपने नाम पर ट्रांसफर कराना होगा। उसके बाद आप कंपनी या IEPF से उन्हें क्लेम कर सकते हैं।

question.english: Who is RTA?
question.hinglish: RTA kaun hota hai?
question.hindi: RTA कौन होता है?

answer.english: RTA stands for Registrar and Transfer Agent. They are appointed by companies to maintain shareholder records, handle share transfers, dividend payments, and other related activities.
answer.hinglish: RTA ka matlab Registrar and Transfer Agent hota hai. Ye companies ke shareholder records manage karte hain aur transfers, dividends jaise kaam sambhalte hain.
answer.hindi: RTA का मतलब Registrar and Transfer Agent होता है। कंपनियाँ इन्हें शेयरधारकों के रिकॉर्ड को बनाए रखने और शेयर ट्रांसफर, लाभांश भुगतान जैसे कार्यों के लिए नियुक्त करती हैं।

question.english: What does RTA Do?
question.hinglish: RTA kya karta hai?
question.hindi: RTA क्या करता है?

answer.english:
RTA's primary responsibilities include:
Maintaining shareholder records.
Processing share transfers and transmissions.
Handling dividend payments and reconciliation.
Issuing share certificates (in physical form).
Dealing with shareholder queries and grievances.
answer.hinglish:
- Shareholder record maintain karta hai
- Share transfer aur transmission process handle karta hai
- Dividend distribute karta hai
- Physical share certificate issue karta hai
- Complaints ka resolution karta hai
answer.hindi:
RTA की मुख्य जिम्मेदारियाँ हैं:
- शेयरधारकों के रिकॉर्ड का रख-रखाव
- शेयर ट्रांसफर व ट्रांसमिशन की प्रक्रिया
- लाभांश भुगतान
- फिजिकल शेयर सर्टिफिकेट जारी करना
- शेयरधारकों की शिकायतों का समाधान करना

question.english: What is a Dividend Warrant?
question.hinglish: Dividend Warrant kya hota hai?
question.hindi: Dividend Warrant क्या होता है?

answer.english: A dividend warrant is a document issued by a company to a shareholder as a payment for dividends. It is like a cheque and can be encashed at a bank.
answer.hinglish: Dividend Warrant ek aisa document hota hai jise company dividend pay karne ke liye issue karti hai — yeh basically ek cheque hota hai jo bank mein deposit hota hai.
answer.hindi: Dividend Warrant वह दस्तावेज होता है जिसे कंपनी लाभांश के भुगतान हेतु शेयरधारक को जारी करती है। यह एक तरह का चेक होता है जिसे बैंक में जमा किया जा सकता है।

question.english: What can we do if the Folio Number is not available but the Dividend Warrant is Available?
question.hinglish: Agar Folio Number nahi pata ho lekin Dividend Warrant ho to kya karein?
question.hindi: यदि Folio Number उपलब्ध न हो पर Dividend Warrant हो तो क्या करें?

answer.english: You should contact the company's RTA with the dividend warrant and request them to provide you with the folio number. They should be able to trace it based on the information on the warrant.
answer.hinglish: Aap RTA se contact karke apna Dividend Warrant dikha kar Folio Number trace kar sakte hain.
answer.hindi: आप कंपनी के RTA से संपर्क करें और Dividend Warrant प्रस्तुत करें। वे उस जानकारी के आधार पर आपका Folio Number पता कर सकते हैं।

question.english: What is a Folio Number?
question.hinglish: Folio Number kya hota hai?
question.hindi: Folio Number क्या होता है?

answer.english: A folio number is a unique identification number assigned to each shareholder in the company's register. It helps in tracking their shareholding and transactions.
answer.hinglish: Folio Number ek unique ID hoti hai jo har shareholder ko di jaati hai company ke record mein. Isse shares track kiye ja sakte hain.
answer.hindi: Folio Number एक अद्वितीय पहचान संख्या होती है जो प्रत्येक शेयरधारक को कंपनी के रिकॉर्ड में दी जाती है। इससे उनके शेयर होल्डिंग को ट्रैक किया जा सकता है।

question.english: What is a Certificate Number?
question.hinglish: Pramanpatra sankhya kya hai?
question.hindi: प्रमाणपत्र संख्या क्या है?

answer.english: A certificate number is a unique number assigned to each share certificate issued in physical form. It helps in identifying and tracking individual share certificates.
answer.hinglish: Pramanpatra sankhya har physical share certificate par likhi ek unique number hoti hai. Isse certificate ki pehchaan aur tracking hoti hai.
answer.hindi: प्रमाणपत्र संख्या प्रत्येक भौतिक शेयर प्रमाणपत्र को दी गई एक अद्वितीय संख्या होती है। यह प्रमाणपत्र की पहचान और ट्रैकिंग में सहायक होती है।

question.english: What is the 1st Step taken for Claiming Shares?
question.hinglish: Share claim karne ka pehla step kya hai?
question.hindi: शेयर क्लेम करने के लिए पहला कदम क्या है?

answer.english: The first step is to ascertain the status of the shares (whether they are with the company, in the suspense account, or transferred to IEPF). Then, you need to gather all the necessary documents related to your shareholding and carry out KYC updation.
answer.hinglish: Sabse pehle yeh pata lagana hai ki aapke shares kahan hain (company ke paas, suspense account mein ya IEPF mein transfer ho chuke hain). Uske baad related documents jama karke KYC update karna hota hai.
answer.hindi: पहला कदम यह जानना है कि आपके शेयर कहाँ हैं (कंपनी के पास, सस्पेंस खाते में या IEPF में ट्रांसफर हो चुके हैं)। इसके बाद संबंधित दस्तावेज़ एकत्र करें और KYC अपडेट कराएं।

question.english: What is KYC Updation? What documents are required to submit for KYC Updation?
question.hinglish: KYC update kya hota hai? Kaunse documents dene hote hain?
question.hindi: KYC अपडेट क्या है? इसके लिए कौन-कौन से दस्तावेज़ देने होते हैं?

answer.english:
KYC (Know Your Customer) updation is the process of verifying the identity and address of the investor. Generally, you will need:
Identity proof (PAN card, Aadhaar card, Voter ID, etc.)
Address proof (Aadhaar card, Passport, Utility bills, etc.)
Cancelled cheque or bank account details
Proof of shareholding (share certificates, dividend warrants, etc.)
answer.hinglish:
KYC (Know Your Customer) ek process hai jisse investor ki identity aur address verify kiya jata hai. Zaruri documents:
- Pehchaan proof (PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID etc.)
- Address proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Bijli bill etc.)
- Cancelled cheque ya bank details
- Shareholding proof (Share certificate, dividend warrant etc.)
answer.hindi:
KYC (Know Your Customer) अपडेट एक प्रक्रिया है जिससे निवेशक की पहचान और पता सत्यापित किया जाता है। आवश्यक दस्तावेज़:
- पहचान प्रमाण (PAN कार्ड, आधार कार्ड, वोटर ID आदि)
- पता प्रमाण (आधार कार्ड, पासपोर्ट, बिजली का बिल आदि)
- रद्द चेक या बैंक विवरण
- शेयरधारिता का प्रमाण (शेयर सर्टिफिकेट, डिविडेंड वारंट आदि)

question.english: Is a Demat Account Compulsory for Claiming back shares?
question.hinglish: Kya share claim karne ke liye Demat account zaruri hai?
question.hindi: क्या शेयर क्लेम करने के लिए डिमैट खाता अनिवार्य है?

answer.english: Yes, a Demat account is now mandatory for claiming shares from IEPF. The shares will be transferred to your Demat account after approval of your claim.
answer.hinglish: Haan, ab IEPF se share claim karne ke liye valid demat account hona mandatory hai. Shares directly aapke demat account mein transfer hote hain.
answer.hindi: हाँ, अब IEPF से शेयर क्लेम करने के लिए डिमैट खाता अनिवार्य है। क्लेम स्वीकृत होने पर शेयर आपके डिमैट खाते में ट्रांसफर किए जाते हैं।

question.english: What is a Client Master List?
question.hinglish: Client Master List kya hoti hai?
question.hindi: क्लाइंट मास्टर लिस्ट क्या होती है?

answer.english: A client master list is a document maintained by the Depository Participant (DP) that contains all the details of the Demat account holders, including their personal information, PAN, address, and Demat account details.
answer.hinglish: Client Master List ek document hota hai jo DP (Depository Participant) maintain karta hai. Isme demat account holder ka naam, PAN, address, aur account details hote hain.
answer.hindi: क्लाइंट मास्टर लिस्ट एक दस्तावेज़ होता है जिसे डिपॉजिटरी पार्टिसिपेंट (DP) द्वारा बनाए रखा जाता है, जिसमें डिमैट अकाउंट धारक की व्यक्तिगत जानकारी, PAN, पता और खाता विवरण शामिल होता है।

question.english: What happens to the Unclaimed Dividend Amount?
question.hinglish: Unclaimed dividend ka kya hota hai?
question.hindi: अप्राप्त लाभांश राशि का क्या होता है?

answer.english: if a dividend remains unclaimed by a shareholder, it is transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) after a specified period (usually seven years), where it can be claimed by the rightful owner by submitting a claim form to the relevant authorities managed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs; essentially, the unclaimed dividend is not lost but held in a fund for potential future claims by the shareholder.
answer.hinglish: Agar shareholder ne declared dividend specified time mein receive nahi kiya, to woh amount 7 saal ke baad IEPF mein transfer ho jaata hai. Baad mein claim kiya ja sakta hai.
answer.hindi: यदि कोई लाभांश शेयरधारक द्वारा निर्धारित समय में प्राप्त नहीं किया जाता है, तो वह राशि सात वर्षों के बाद IEPF में ट्रांसफर कर दी जाती है। लाभार्थी इस राशि को उचित दावा पत्र भरकर वापस प्राप्त कर सकता है।

question.english: How and where to Open Demat Account?
question.hinglish: Demat account kaise aur kahan kholen?
question.hindi: डिमैट खाता कैसे और कहाँ खोलें?

answer.english: You can open a Demat account with a SEBI-registered Depository Participant (DP). Many brokerage firms, banks, and financial institutions act as DPs. The process usually involves filling out an account opening form, submitting KYC documents (PAN card, address proof, etc.), and agreeing to the terms and conditions. You can open a Demat account online or offline.
answer.hinglish: Aap kisi SEBI registered DP ke through online ya offline demat account khol sakte hain. Iske liye KYC documents, form aur aapki approval chahiye hoti hai.
answer.hindi: आप किसी SEBI-पंजीकृत डिपॉजिटरी पार्टिसिपेंट (DP) के माध्यम से डिमैट खाता खोल सकते हैं। यह प्रक्रिया ऑनलाइन या ऑफलाइन हो सकती है और इसके लिए KYC दस्तावेज़, फॉर्म और सहमति की आवश्यकता होती है।

question.english: Does shares jointly held by people require their demat account in joint name? How many Holders in One demat account?
question.hinglish: Agar shares joint naam mein ho to kya joint demat account zaruri hai? Ek demat account mein kitne holders ho sakte hain?
question.hindi: यदि शेयर संयुक्त रूप से होल्ड किए गए हैं तो क्या संयुक्त नाम में डिमैट खाता आवश्यक है? एक डिमैट खाते में कितने धारक हो सकते हैं?

answer.english: Yes, shares held jointly should ideally be reflected in a Demat account held jointly by the same individuals. More than one individual can hold a Demat account jointly. The exact limit on the number of joint holders may vary by DP, but it is usually a reasonable number (e.g., up to three).
answer.hinglish: Haan, joint shares ke liye joint holders ko milkar demat account open karna padta hai. Usually ek demat account mein 2 ya 3 holders ho sakte hain.
answer.hindi: हाँ, संयुक्त शेयरों के लिए वही व्यक्ति संयुक्त रूप से डिमैट खाता खोलें जिनके नाम पर शेयर हैं। आम तौर पर 2-3 व्यक्ति एक डिमैट खाता संयुक्त रूप से होल्ड कर सकते हैं।

question.english: How to Download Client Master List from Demat account?
question.hinglish: Demat account se Client Master List kaise download karein?
question.hindi: डिमैट खाते से क्लाइंट मास्टर लिस्ट कैसे डाउनलोड करें?

answer.english: You can usually download the client master list (detailing your holdings) from your DP's online portal or by contacting their customer service. The process varies depending on the DP.
answer.hinglish: Apne DP ki website ya portal par login karke CML download kar sakte hain. Ya fir DP ke customer service se contact karke bhi mil sakti hai.
answer.hindi: आप अपने DP की वेबसाइट या पोर्टल पर जाकर क्लाइंट मास्टर लिस्ट डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं या ग्राहक सेवा से संपर्क करके प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। प्रक्रिया DP पर निर्भर करती है।

question.english: What are basic documents needed for NRI?
question.hinglish: NRI ke liye kaunse documents chahiye?
question.hindi: NRI के लिए आवश्यक मूल दस्तावेज़ क्या हैं?

answer.english:
NRIs need to provide documents like their PAN card, overseas address proof, Indian address proof (if applicable), passport, visa details, PIO or OCI card (if applicable), and any other documents specified by the DP and regulations.
ISR Forms & Share Certificates
answer.hinglish: NRI ko PAN, Indian aur foreign address proof (agar applicable ho), passport, visa, PIO/OCI card (agar applicable ho) aur other valid documents dene hote hain.
answer.hindi: NRI को PAN कार्ड, विदेशी और भारतीय पता प्रमाण (यदि लागू हो), पासपोर्ट, वीजा विवरण, PIO/OCI कार्ड (यदि लागू हो), और अन्य प्रासंगिक दस्तावेज़ प्रस्तुत करने होते हैं।

question.english: What is ISR 1 Form?
question.hinglish: ISR-1 Form kya hai?

answer.english: Form ISR-1 is an Investor Service Request form that allows investors to request changes to their PAN, KYC details, or nominations. It is used to register or update details for securities held in physical form, such as shares, bonds, or debentures
answer.hinglish: ISR-1 ek Investor Service Request Form hai jo PAN, KYC details ya nomination update karne ke liye use hota hai, especially physical securities ke cases mein.

question.english: What is ISR 2 Form? It should be attested by Bank Manager?
question.hinglish: ISR-2 Form kya hai? Kya isey bank manager se verify karana zaruri hai?

answer.english: Form ISR-2 is a bank form that verifies the signature of a securities holder. It is used to update the signature of a securities holder. The bank manager attests the form by confirming that the signature matches the one on file with the bank.
answer.hinglish: ISR-2 ek form hai jisme bank manager investor ke signature ko certify karta hai. Yeh ensure karta hai ki aapke bank mein diye gaye signature match karte hain.

question.english: Who can be Nominee?
question.hinglish: Nominee kaun ho sakta hai?

answer.english: A nominee can be a family member, friend, or any trusted person. The person who appoints the nominee is called the policyholder or account holder..
answer.hinglish: Nominee koi bhi family member, friend ya trusted person ho sakta hai jise aap apne shares ke liye nominate karte hain.

question.english: What is ISR 3 Form?
question.hinglish: ISR-3 Form kya hai?

answer.english: Form ISR-3 is a declaration form for opting out of nomination for physical securities in listed companies. It is used by investors who do not want to name a person to receive their securities in the event of their death.
answer.hinglish: ISR-3 ek declaration form hai jisme investor batata hai ki woh nomination nahi karna chahta. Yeh bhi physical securities ke liye hota hai.

question.english: Is SH 13 Form for Registering Nominee in the Folio Number?
question.hinglish: Kya SH-13 Form folio number ke liye nominee register karne ke liye hota hai?

answer.english: Yes, "SH 13 Form" is specifically used to register a nominee for a particular folio number, meaning it is the form used to designate who will inherit your shares in the event of your death, linked to your specific folio number in a company's shareholding records.
answer.hinglish: Haan, SH-13 ka use kisi specific folio ke liye nominee register karne ke liye hota hai.

question.english: We have to submit both ISR 3 and SH 13 Form?
question.hinglish: Kya dono forms ISR-3 aur SH-13 submit karne padte hain?

answer.english: Yes, you may need to submit both Form SH-13 and Form ISR-3, depending on whether you want to nominate someone or opt out of nomination.
answer.hinglish: Nahi, aapko ya to SH-13 ya ISR-3 mein se ek submit karna hota hai, yeh depend karta hai ki aap nomination karna chahte hain ya nahi.

question.english: Which documents are required when there is a change of Surname of Holder?
question.hinglish: Agar surname change ho jaye to kaunse documents lagenge?

answer.english: Documents typically required include the old share certificate(s), a copy of the marriage certificate (for married women), a copy of the gazette notification (if applicable), identity proof, address proof, and a letter explaining the change.
answer.hinglish: Old share certificates, marriage certificate (agar married woman hai), gazette notification (agar applicable ho), ID proof, address proof aur ek letter dena padta hai.

question.english: Is Marriage Certificate a Valid document for Name change of Female in occasion of Marriage?
question.hinglish: Kya marriage certificate valid proof hai name change ke liye?

answer.english: Yes, a marriage certificate is generally considered a valid document for a name change for a female after marriage.
answer.hinglish: Haan, marriage ke baad name change ke liye marriage certificate ek valid proof mana jata hai.

question.english: When Name change Gazette is Needed?
question.hinglish: Name change ke liye gazette notification kab zaruri hoti hai?

answer.english: A gazette notification is usually required when the name change is due to reasons other than marriage (e.g., personal choice, divorce). It is also sometimes required even after marriage, depending on the company's specific requirements.
answer.hinglish: Gazette notification tab zaruri hoti hai jab name change kisi personal reason, divorce, ya other non-marriage reason se hua ho.

question.english: In case of married female, whether passport having name of spouse is a valid document for proof of name change?
question.hinglish: Kya married woman ke passport mein husband ka naam hona valid name change proof hai?

answer.english: A passport with the spouse's name is generally accepted as supporting proof of a name change after marriage.
answer.hinglish: Haan, agar married woman ke passport mein husband ka naam likha hai to usse valid name change proof mana jata hai.

question.english: What to do when Share certificate is not available?

answer.english: If a share certificate is lost, you need to apply for a duplicate share certificate by following the procedure mentioned for lost certificates (ISR forms, affidavit, indemnity bond, advertisement, etc.).

question.english: What is the procedure for duplicate share for loss of share certificates?

answer.english: The procedure involves filing an FIR with the police, submitting ISR forms (ISR-1, ISR-2, and possibly ISR-4), providing an affidavit and indemnity bond, publishing a notice in the newspaper, and paying the required fees.

question.english: For Issuing Duplicate share certificate we have to submit Affidavit and Indemnity Bond?

answer.english: Yes, an affidavit and indemnity bond are mandatory for obtaining a duplicate share certificate.

question.english: For Issuing Duplicate share certificate we have to submit Affidavit and Indemnity Bond, It should be print on stamp paper and Duly Notarized?

answer.english: Yes, the affidavit and indemnity bond should be printed on the appropriate stamp paper (as per the stamp duty applicable in your state) and duly notarized.
